question: Rukmini Devi Arundale is a famous classical dancer of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was an Indian theosophist, **dancer and choreographer of Bharatanatyam, **an Indian classical dance form, and animal rights campaigner.
 
• She was the** first woman in Indian history to be elected to the Rajya Sabha**, the country's highest house of parliament.
 
• She was the most prominent revivalist of Bharatanatyam from** its original 'Sadhir' style, **which was popular among temple dancers, the Devadasis, and she also sought to restore old Indian arts and crafts.
 
• Rukmini Devi was named one of India Today's** "100 People Who Shaped India."**
 
• In 1956, she received the Padma Bhushan, and in 1967, she received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a significant Hindu form of Indian classical dance.
 
• **The initial sources of Bharatanatyam **are regarded to be Bharata Muni's Natya Shastra and Nandikeshvara's Abhinaya Darpana (Mirror of Gesture) (an Indian classical dance form).
 
• The dance form is also briefly addressed in Someshwara III's Kannada work Manasollasa.
 
• Since ancient times, it has thrived in the temples and courts of southern India.
 
• It is one of eight well-known Indian classical dance genres that reflects South Indian religious themes and spiritual ideals, particularly those of Shaivism, Vaishnavism, and Shaktism, collectively known as Hinduism.
